title: oenothera hexandra subsp. gracilis
intro: Oenothera hexandra subsp. gracilis, commonly known as Evening Primrose, is a plant species belonging to the Onagraceae family. This plant is valued for its seeds, which contain gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), an essential fatty acid with potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Evening Primrose include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as atopic dermatitis and menopausal hot flashes. The bioactive constituents of Oenothera hexandra subsp. gracilis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
